seo_title: Find Last-Minute Scholarships for International Students USA
seo_description: Last-minute scholarships for international students in the USA. Compare deadlines, award details, and eligibility, then apply on provider application paths.
intro: Trying to apply before a near-term cutoff changes how you search. This USA scholarship view pulls together a focused set of listings that match international student intent and last-minute timing, so you can find options that may still be open soon and compare them quickly. The programs below span areas such as Education, STEM, Medicine, Humanities, Community, and more, with examples touching engineering, medical mission work, public service, and coding. Award amounts vary by listing and should be structured on the provider application path, and deadlines differ by program rather than following one shared date. Requirements also vary: some listings may ask for essays, while others appear lighter-touch, so it is worth reading each row closely before you apply.

faq.question: How can I find last-minute scholarships for international students in the USA?
faq.answer: Use this filtered view to compare rows that match international-student eligibility and near-term deadlines. When a provider application path is available, ScholarshipTop includes it so you can move from shortlist to submission more easily.

faq.answer: Possibly—this slice includes listings tied to international_student, while some rows may also mention us_citizen or us_permanent_resident. Check each scholarship’s provider application path before you apply, because eligibility varies by program.
